learning_outcomes.text: Describe what Gemini in Sheets can and cannot do and its data boundaries
Prompt Gemini to generate formulas and tables
Ask Gemini to summarise and explain a dataset
Verify Gemini output against the source data
Use Gemini to clean and categorise data responsibly
Apply governance, privacy and review practices to AI-assisted work

integrative_case: A manager pastes a messy quarterly export and wants a summarised, categorised table with a short narrative: prompt Gemini to draft formulas and a summary, then independently verify every figure against the source rows, document what was checked, and flag anything the model got wrong before sharing.
